name: Terapi Integration Connection
description: Structure documentation for an integration connection in Terapi, representing an authenticated link between an end-user account and a third-party service.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Your application's unique identifier for this connection. This is the connection ID you provide when creating the connection - typically your user ID or tenant ID.

fields.name: provider_config_key
fields.description: The key of the integration configuration this connection belongs to (e.g., 'github-prod', 'salesforce-sandbox')

fields.name: provider
fields.description: The third-party provider name from Terapi's supported providers list (e.g., 'github', 'salesforce', 'slack', 'hubspot', 'stripe')

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the connection was established

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the connection was last updated (e.g., token refresh)

fields.name: metadata
fields.description: Custom key-value metadata stored with this connection. Use for tenant IDs, display names, scoping information, etc.

fields.name: credentials
fields.description: Current credential state. Raw secrets are never returned - only status information.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Credential type used for this connection

fields.name: expires_at
fields.description: Token expiration time for OAuth connections
